# yp (YitPush)

> AI-powered CLI tool for Git commit automation and Azure DevOps management.
> Supports multiple AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM.

## Project

- Version: 2.3.0
- Language: C# / .NET 10
- Install: `dotnet tool install -g YitPush`
- Command: `yp`
- Repository: https://github.com/elvisbrevi/yitpush
- AI provider setup: `yp setup` (TUI by default; `--wizard` for the legacy 5-step flow)

## Commands

- `yp setup` — configure AI provider in the TUI (auto-falls-back to `--wizard` in CI)
- `yp commit` — stage, commit, and push with an AI-generated message (supports `--conventional`, `--type`, `--scope`, `--detect-breaking`, `--amend`, `--template`)
- `yp pr` — interactive menu (list / show / comments / reply / create / generate AI description)
- `yp pr list` — list open pull requests in the current repo
- `yp pr show <pr-id>` — show a single PR (title, description, reviewers)
- `yp pr comments <pr-id>` — list all discussion threads with file/line context (REST API)
- `yp pr reply <pr-id> <thread-id> --body "..."` — post a reply to a thread
- `yp pr create --source <branch> --target <branch> --title <title> [--body-file <path>] [--auto-complete]` — open a new PR
- `yp checkout` — interactive branch checkout
- `yp diff` — working-tree or branch-to-branch diff (`--files`, `--hunks`, `--stat`, `--json`)
- `yp skill` — install the yp skill for your AI agent
- `yp azure-devops` — Azure DevOps management (repos, user stories, tasks, links)
- `yp azure-devops resolve-field <org> <project> <workItemType> <displayName>` — print a work-item field refname
- `yp azure-devops refresh-fields <org> <project> <workItemType>` — invalidate and re-warm the field cache
- `yp azure-devops task delete <org> <id> [--yes]` — move a work item to the recycle bin
- `yp azure-devops task attach <org> <project> <id> <file-path> [--comment "..."]` — upload a file as an AttachedFile
- `yp --version` / `yp -V` — print the assembly version (e.g. `2.3.0`) and exit 0

## Key flags

- `--language <lang>`, `--lang`, `-l` — output language for commit/PR (default: english)
- `--detailed` — generate a detailed commit or PR description with full body
- `--confirm` — require confirmation before committing (commit only)
- `--save` — save output to a markdown file
- `--conventional` — emit Conventional Commits `<type>(<scope>): <subject>` (optionally with `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)
- `--json` — emit a stable JSON envelope on stdout (no ANSI escapes) for `hu show`, `task show`, `hu list`, `pr list/show/comments/reply/create`, `yp diff`
- `--no-spinner` — skip the AnsiConsole.Status() spinner for long ops (also honored via the `YITPUSH_NO_SPINNER` env var)

## Configuration

Config file: `~/.yitpush/config.json`
Supported providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM
Provider env-var overrides: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `NVIDIA_API_KEY`
Default commit format can be set per project under `"commitFormat"` in `~/.yitpush/config.json` (`"conventional"`, `"plain"`, `"gitmoji"`, or a path to a template file).
